task_template: Reach g; avoid {obstacle_0} A and {obstacle_1} B.

dynamics.rollout_semantics: Nominal kinematic states are retained after a predicted collision for scoring and display. Only the selected first action is eligible for execution, and its swept segment must pass a separate collision guard. No later action is executed by this fixture.
dynamics.collision_boundary: Closed obstacles: tangency or boundary contact counts as collision. Leaving the closed scene bounds also counts as collision.

objective.formula: J = terminal_squared_distance + effort_weight * sum(||a[k]||_2^2) + collision_penalty * C
objective.effort_meaning: Quadratic control effort in dimensionless scene coordinates; not a physical energy measurement.
objective.C_definition: 1 iff any swept segment intersects any closed obstacle or leaves the scene bounds; otherwise 0
objective.selection: Minimum finite J among the three supplied candidates; ties broken by fixture order. A finite collision penalty is not a general feasibility guarantee. The selected candidate is entirely collision-free in this fixture.
objective.execute: Only the selected candidate's first action, after confirming its swept segment is collision-free.

renderer.state_access: Planner receives exact scene state and generated task; there is no image-to-state inference or learned vision model.
